propositions: Releases must be initiated only from the protected main branch via workflow_dispatch and bound to a reviewed, tested Gerrit-landed revision, eliminating the unprotected v* tag publish path.

A committed store-format-version/required-capability record must ship in v1.0 so binaries fail closed on incompatible stores, treating an absent record as legacy/compatible (fail-open) and failing closed only when present-but-incompatible.

The default python -m build wheel-from-sdist path bakes COMMIT=None into the published wheel and CI installs the source tree instead of the built artifact, so the exact wheel and sdist must be built once and exercised before publication.
Every release-dependent executable, action, and the OIDC-privileged mcp-publisher must be identified by an immutable SHA-pinned reference with checksum/signature verification.
Removed environment variables and TOML keys affecting store location, write/sync gates, auth, or close policy must be detected and tombstoned rather than silently ignored.
A rollback-safe outcome must be documented for a pre-v1.0 binary encountering the store compatibility record, with docs updated to describe the upgrade/rollback path.
